about: The golden set of the letter checks (#78): invented people, postings and letter sentences, each labelled with what the checks must say. Run before a change to a prompt or to a claim rule ships: tests/test_letter_evals.py. Add a case for every false alarm or missed claim found; never change a label to make a run pass.
